unlisted_practices: Comparing deep learning-accelerated MRI sequence with conventional sequence, with and without antispasmodic (hyoscine butylbromide) administration, on image quality and diagnostic confidence

screen.reason: The study evaluates a deep-learning accelerated MRI reconstruction sequence deployed on an active 3T scanner and tests an operational protocol variation (administration of hyoscine butylbromide to reduce motion artifacts vs without) to assess its impact on image quality and diagnostic confidence.

primary.practice: comparing imaging protocol with vs without antispasmodic medication (HBB) administration
